description: A recent visit documents a dose increase; a home medication list on file hasn't caught up.
input_notes: Cardiology follow-up: Hypertension inadequately controlled. Amlodipine increased to 10 mg oral once daily, up from the previous 5 mg dose. Continue Atorvastatin 20 mg oral nightly.
Home Medication List (on file, last updated 2 months ago): Amlodipine 5 mg oral once daily. Atorvastatin 20 mg oral nightly.

possible_inconsistencies: Amlodipine dose differs between the cardiology note (10 mg) and the home medication list (5 mg).
expected.summary: Two medications, amlodipine and atorvastatin, are documented; amlodipine's dose differs between the two sources (10 mg vs. 5 mg), while atorvastatin is consistent.
